verdict.rationale: Sentry documents Seer Agent, which lets you 'ask any question about your application' and finds the right telemetry to answer it. Its official MCP server also lets AI assistants search errors and analyze performance in natural language. Trace Explorer separately supports flexible queries and visualizations, but nothing shows the natural-language path returning an editable query or chart, which is the second half of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that NL questions produce a real query or chart/dashboard widget, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer Agent's telemetry Q&A.
